This is not a bug, it's a feature.

The social status of your profile does not change the discoverability of instances, it only hides the location from your social profile. Photon servers are separate from the social status and API.

Public, Group Public, Friends+, Friends, (Group+? Group?) instances are discoverable from the Photon servers. If you don't want to be joinable and don't want an instance to be discoverable from the world list, make an Invite or Invite+ instance, or close the instance.
